scope_notes: The two seeds are DDIM sampling seeds, not independent training seeds; average both per recording/regime/model/arm, then average clean/noisy per recording before bootstrap.

Fresh source GT/rest/sensor arrays and full identities are exact. GPU-saved references are exact across all10 model/arm/seed outputs per source; fresh CPU reference uses atol=rtol=2e-5. Full CPU/GPU recursive input hashes are not claimed bit-exact.
Low-speed foot mask is GT 3D joint speed<0.2m/s at30Hz. Predicted horizontal foot speed on that mask is a proxy, not velocity error or measured contact.
FootY is absolute prediction-vs-GT joint-height error on all192*2 samples, not sole clearance or full-scene penetration.
World/PA use192*22 samples, acceleration190*22; differences stay within each window. Observed-head effectiveN is stored separately because row.counts omits it.

Full saved metric schema is recomputed using the frozen CPU metric functions. The independent implementation uses unchanged native FK followed by separate NumPy formulas for World/PA, head, root/height, stance-speed and stride metrics; added direct formulas independently cover full-frame footY and acceleration.
Only registered fusion-vs-both-comparators criteria determine formalpass/reject. Control-vs41k and same-model sceneon/off are descriptive evidence, not a new preregisteredpass.
All43 sampledVALrecordings include dev12+confirmation31; this is not allRICHVALwindows or TEST. Prior baseline reports may have included these validationidentities.

GuidanceOFF is verified by runtime guidecallcount0. The general loader returns trained_guidance metadata but does not disable runtime solver; delivery must explicitly set guidance_enabled=False, or set only physical_guidance.enabled=False in the inference configuration while retaining IK and learnedfeedback.
